This week’s threats keep finding leverage in small things that were easy to overlook. items.title: The Credential Layer Is Expanding Faster Than Security Teams Can See It

items.title: Realtek Jungle SDK Exploit Attempts Deliver Cling Botnet With STUN-Based C2
items.summary: Threat actors have been observed attempting to exploit a now-patched critical security flaw impacting the Realtek Jungle software development kit (SDK) to deploy a botnet malware called Cling.
